subject: Implementation readiness: SDK pilot architecture checklist
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Samuel Kim <samuel.kim@polarishealth.com>, Meera Ramachandran <meera.ramachandran@polarishealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Jun 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Implementation readiness: SDK pilot architecture checklist

Hi Samuel / Meera —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps to get the SDK pilot moving toward a local proof-of-concept: 

1) Goal: ship a small end-to-end sample that shows authentication, routing to our hosted model, and a simple embeddings/reranker flow for a subset of Polaris clinical documents.
2) Tech scope: Python + TypeScript SDK examples (local dev + containerized), minimal network egress test, and a sandbox key for dev.
3) Owners: Redwood SE (Marcus) will provide quickstart artifacts; Polaris to provision a staging VM or share a short-lived VPC test window for an egress check.

Attachments: network_topology.png (stub) — a very lightweight sketch of suggested outbound rules and proxy placement.

Can you confirm the following by EOD tomorrow so Marcus can tailor the quickstart?
- Which language you want prioritized (python / ts / both)
- Who is the cloud contact to coordinate the egress test (name + email)
- Any compliance gating (e.g., strict egress via private link) beyond SOC2-level controls we discussed

I’ll loop in scheduling for a 30m kickoff once we have answers.

Thanks,
Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Senior AE, Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Samuel Kim <samuel.kim@polarishealth.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Jun 2027 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Implementation readiness: SDK pilot architecture checklist

Thanks, Evelyn — I started drafting a technical checklist and attached a tiny quickstart bundle (redwood-sdk-quickstart.zip) with both a Python sample and a TS example. Attachment is a stub (install scripts + minimal app).

Checklist (high level):
- Auth
  - Use API keys for the initial pilot. Recommend service-account-style keys rotated monthly.
  - For private deployments use KMS-backed key material; we'll provide KMS integration examples.
- Networking
  - Outbound to api.redwood.example.com:443 (TLS) — IP allowlist available if you need static egress.
  - For VPC/private customers we support VPC peering and private endpoints; if you want to avoid egress, we can show a VPN+private endpoint pattern.
- SDK setup
  - Python: venv, pip install redwood==0.7.1, example includes local caching for embeddings to avoid repeated compute.
  - TS: npm init + @redwood/sdk, sample uses fetch + streaming response handler.
- Routing & model variants
  - We expose a routing header to pin model family and latency tiers (x-redwood-model, x-redwood-tier).
  - Canary policy example included in the sample apps.
- Structured output / tool-calling
  - Quick example of function/tool calling included in examples/tool_calling.ts and python_tool_calling.py.
- Embeddings & reranking
  - Small test harness that computes embeddings for a 100-doc subset and runs a simple dot-product rerank.
  - Caching layer suggested for repeated queries.
- Security/compliance
  - We attached a short SOC2_response_summary.pdf that lists evidence artifacts we can provide.

Small inline snippet (Python auth example):

from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key="REDACTED")
resp = client.generate(prompt="Summarize this clinical note.")
print(resp.text)

I can walk through the sample on a quick call; if you prefer, I’ll push the sample to a temporary GitHub repo and share a short README.

– Marcus

From: Samuel Kim <samuel.kim@polarishealth.com>

Cc: Meera Ramachandran <meera.ramachandran@polarishealth.com>, cloudops@polarishealth.com
Date: Wed, 02 Jun 2027 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Implementation readiness: SDK pilot architecture checklist

Thanks — helpful checklist. A few quick clarifications before we schedule the kickoff: 

1) Language priority: Python first, TS second — most of our infra automation is Python.
2) Egress: We prefer to avoid public egress for PHI-shaped metadata. Can you confirm if static IP ranges are possible or if private endpoint is required? Our Cloud Ops (cc'd) will need the details.
3) Keys: Service-account-style keys are fine for the pilot. For longer-term we'd prefer KMS/HSM integration.
4) Sample app: Will the quickstart include a local Dockerfile we can run to validate calls from our staging VM?

If you can reply inline to the points above, that would be great — then we can set the kickoff time.

Sam
Samuel Kim
Lead ML Engineer, Polaris Health
(s) +1 617-555-3344

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 02 Jun 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Implementation readiness: SDK pilot architecture checklist

Sam — great questions. Quick answers and next steps: 

1) Python first — noted. Marcus will surface the Python examples first and push the Dockerfile into the quickstart bundle.
2) Networking options:
   - Static IP ranges: yes — we offer published egress IP ranges you can whitelist. Marcus, I think you can attach the current ranges to the HubSpot deal.
   - Private endpoint: supported — for PHI-sensitive traffic we recommend a private endpoint pattern (we’ll provide the template).
3) Keys: Service-account keys for pilot, KMS/HSM for production. We’ll include an example of KMS-wrapped keys in the repo.
4) Sample app / Dockerfile: Marcus to add a Dockerfile and a docker-compose that runs the python sample + a local redis cache for embeddings.

Next steps and owners: 
- Marcus: push the temp GitHub repo with Python quickstart + Dockerfile, include egress IP list and KMS example (due: Thu EOD PST).
- Polaris Cloud Ops: confirm whether static IP whitelist or private endpoint is preferred (owner: cloudops@polarishealth.com).
- Evelyn: schedule 30m kickoff once repo is available (I'll send a calendar invite).

Scheduling link: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=redwood-pilot-kickoff
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/3421

If that works I’ll shoot a calendar invite for Friday next week.

Best,
Evelyn
